avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 2 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 29.

facts.text: Snow left Harts Pass (6,490 ft) and Brown Top (5,850 ft) between 1 day earlier and 8 days later this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Harts Pass
evidence.detail: left June 14; earlier seasons: June 3 (2023), June 16 (2024), June 6 (2025)

evidence.name: Brown Top
evidence.detail: left June 16; earlier seasons: June 11 (2023), June 22 (2024), June 17 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the highest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Harts Pass (6,490 ft) and Brown Top (5,850 ft).

evidence.name: Harts Pass
evidence.detail: 59.7 in on April 5; earlier seasons: 53.6 in (2023), 36.2 in (2024), 37.1 in (2025)

evidence.name: Brown Top
evidence.detail: 62.7 in on April 3; earlier seasons: 56.5 in (2023), 36.0 in (2024), 50.4 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between May 21 and July 8, carried from the melt-out dates at Harts Pass (6,490 ft) and Brown Top (5,850 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Harts Pass
evidence.detail: melted out June 14, 372 ft above the pass; points to May 14 to July 2

evidence.name: Brown Top
evidence.detail: melted out June 16, 268 ft below the pass; points to May 28 to July 14
